title: 08 — Jeszcze pokwitować
description: Halinka: Jeszcze pokwitować. Sirock podpisuje odbiór na tej samej prawej części biurka, trofeum stoi obok. Po podpisie zabiera je i wychodzi; nie pokazujemy żadnych nadnaturalnych działań. Zbliżenie od strony petentów. Ciągłość ulewy: Sirock przemoczona, mokre blond włosy i czarne ubranie, krople na skórze; bez kurtki i parasola. Wnętrze i Halinka suche, deszcz tylko na zewnątrz. Ustawienie statuetki zachowane.

prompts.image: Precise weather/wetness edit of EXACT reference1 movie frame. Preserve composition, lens, all identity/face/body anatomy, poses, hands, gaze direction, furniture, architecture proportions, signs/text, door opening/hinge direction, trophy design/rotation and all props. No redesign or mirror. 16:9 photoreal cinematic, grey overcast daytime with readable faces. Inside DRY office, Sirock signs receipt. Halinka remains dry. NO rain streaks falling indoors, no soaked papers or flooding. Preserve precise fingers, pen, receipt, pointing hand and trophy's frontal smile orientation here. Sirock is visibly SOAKED THROUGH after walking in a downpour without coat or umbrella, entirely indifferent to the rain. Preserve her BLONDE hair color and length but make it genuinely saturated: darker wet blonde strand bundles flattened to scalp, stringy dripping lengths stuck against neck/shoulders, wet fringe against forehead. Visible droplets and water trails on bare shoulders, arms and face; heavy eye makeup slightly damp/smudged but EXACT facial features intact. Black corset/trousers dark wet fabric with restrained water sheen, stays fully OPAQUE and same cut; same silver jewellery. No added jacket/hood/umbrella/towel, no shivering or cold gesture, no supernatural eyes. Image2 wet hair/skin continuity ONLY. Preserve signing scene of image1.
prompts.animation: 0.0–1.9s: Sirock continues a short signature with the pen already in her right hand, keeping its tip on the receipt; her left hand steadies the paper. 1.9–3.0s: She lifts the nib slightly and pauses. Halinka keeps her pointing finger beside the signature area. Camera: locked-off. Secondary motion: minimal movement of wet hair as Sirock breathes. @Image1 anchors Halinka's face; @Image2 anchors Sirock's identity and wet hair only. Preserve paper layout, trophy orientation and existing lettering. Only the small signature mark changes. Avoid lifting the trophy, sliding paper, extra fingers, merged hands, indoor rain or cuts.
